mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN product p ON ws.product_id = p.id AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE p.id IS NOT NULL AND ( (ws.stock_qty - ws.locked_qty) <= 0 OR (p.safety_stock_qty > 0 AND (ws.stock_qty - ws.locked_qty) <= p.safety_stock_qty) )
mapper.select:
SELECT ws.id AS stock_id, ws.warehouse_id AS warehouse_id, ws.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, ws.product_id AS product_id, ws.product_code AS product_code, ws.product_name AS product_name, ws.unit_name AS unit_name, ws.stock_qty AS stock_qty, ws.locked_qty AS locked_qty, p.safety_stock_qty AS safety_stock_qty, p.status AS product_status, ws.update_time AS update_time FROM warehouse_stock ws
ORDER BY (p.safety_stock_qty - (ws.stock_qty - ws.locked_qty)) DESC LIMIT #{limit}
